about_the_game:
Asteroid Forward is a spin-off video game from the Asteroid series, and it’s a vertical-scrolling action arcade game for PC and mobile devices.

FIGHT FEARSOME ENEMIES

The Z9 Galaxy is home to many planets under attack.

Power yourself up with the many POWER-UPS scattered throughout the environment and fight your way to victory!

Free all the planets in the available levels and replay them to collect additional resources.

ENDLESS FUN

In Exploration Mode, you can keep playing even after completing the main campaign levels, constantly moving forward and encountering all kinds of enemies and bosses—some of which you may not have faced before!

Try to beat your high score and earn new rewards!

TAKE ON THE FEARSOME BLACK HOLE RAIDS - COMING SOON AFTER LAUNCH

Special battles against brand-new bosses await you in Asteroid Forward!

Fight solo or team up with a friend in online multiplayer mode to earn incredible rewards.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR SPACESHIP

By playing the various available game modes, you can earn Flact and Aquanium Gems—resources you can use in the Shop to buy new ship styles or other useful items.

Find the style that suits you best!

SEASONS AND EVENTS

Asteroid Forward constantly brings you new content and events to enjoy, thanks to the Forward Pass seasons—available in a free version with 7 useful rewards, or a Premium version (purchasable with Aquanium Gems)!

The Premium Forward Pass includes 2 themed ship styles, Flact, and Aquanium Gems, with a total of 30 levels.

Complete daily missions to level up and finish the current season’s Forward Pass. A new Pass arrives every two months.

Each month also brings new playable events with rewards such as exclusive ship styles and other useful resources.

Log in regularly to discover what’s new!

POWER UP

In addition to the POWER-UPS you'll find throughout the stages, you can also upgrade your spaceship's stats—such as health, damage dealt to enemies, and more—by spending Flact, which you earn simply by playing the game in various modes and opening Astronaut Crates.

Make your way through the universe in Asteroid Forward!
